sections.title: Property tax: Liegenschaftssteuer (Obwalden)

rows.label: Property tax (Liegenschaftssteuer)
rows.value: None in the cantonal tax law: the land taxes it provides are the property gains tax and the transfer tax

rows.label: Minimum tax on real estate
rows.value: A fixed minimum tax of 2 per mille of the net tax value of real estate replaces the ordinary taxes where it is higher (legal entities and natural persons)

source.title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 142 and the minimum tax on real estate

sections.note: An annual tax on the gross value of real estate (no debt deduction), separate from the wealth tax. Rates in per mille are shown as percentages (1.5 per mille = 0.15%).

sections.title: Property transfer tax: Handänderungssteuer (Obwalden)

rows.label: Transfer tax rate (share of the property value)
Who pays
rows.value: Seller and buyer, half each, unless agreed otherwise (yield shared half and half between canton and municipality)

source.title: Obwalden Steuergesetz (StG, GDB 641.4), Stand 1. Januar 2026, Art. 158-163

sections.note: A tax on the transfer of ownership of real estate, separate from the property gains tax (Grundstückgewinnsteuer) on the seller's gain.
